changeSet.author: josh

and.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'shift' AND column_name IN ('start_time', 'end_time') AND (udt_name = 'timetz' OR data_type = 'time with time zone')

changeSet.comment: Update shift table to support timezone-aware scheduling for UTC implementation. Convert start_time and end_time from TIME WITHOUT TIME ZONE to TIMETZ (UTC).
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE shift ALTER COLUMN start_time TYPE timetz USING (to_char(start_time::time, 'HH24:MI:SS') || '+00')::timetz;
ALTER TABLE shift ALTER COLUMN end_time TYPE timetz USING (to_char(end_time::time, 'HH24:MI:SS') || '+00')::timetz;
COMMENT ON COLUMN shift.start_time IS 'Shift start time in UTC (format: HH:MM:SS+00)'; COMMENT ON COLUMN shift.end_time IS 'Shift end time in UTC (format: HH:MM:SS+00)';

rollback.sql: COMMENT ON COLUMN shift.start_time IS NULL; COMMENT ON COLUMN shift.end_time IS NULL;
